_about: Hand-written first-loss labels for every question a t4 baseline run got wrong (dev100 + heldout100, 3 runs each). Drafted by the assistant on 2026-10-12 from the saved answers, judge reasons, replayed contexts and gold turns; to be confirmed by the maintainer. first_loss: answer | retrieval | grading | gold_scope. failure names the answer-side pattern. contributing records a memory-layer signal that pointed the reader the wrong way even though the raw turns were in context. ambiguous items are reported separately and never counted as improvements. Read by tools/t4_baseline_audit.py.
